403.description: Missing or malformed `X-Worker-Key` (it must look like `wk_` followed by 24 to 128 URL-safe characters).

413.description: The voice note is over 4 MB, or (WAV and Ogg only) over 30 seconds, or the whole request is over 5 MB.

422.description: Bad input: empty or over-long text, an unknown `accent_hint` or `reply_language`, no text and no audio.

429.description: A rate limit was hit (per IP or per worker). The `Retry-After` header says how many seconds to wait.
